pairs.difference: Both have a quiet tone-on-tone campfire pattern and no props. A has a saturated yellow-orange field with a mild glow behind the whistle. B is pale and washed out, with a bright white halo around the whistle that lifts the pattern near the hero. The halo looks like a generator glow, but the evidence is weak.
pairs.fix: Keep the backdrop an even tone with the pattern fading quietly. Remove the white glow around the object.

pairs.difference: Both are category 1: a flat cyan field with sunburst rays and no props. B's rays are slightly lighter and soft near the center, but nothing separates the two on staging.
Both are category 2: a red field with a soft shadow and steam, and no props. B has an orange glow at the bottom and A has a darker vignette, but both are plain and quiet.

Both have a purple wall and a plain yellow ledge or table, with the same basket, cloth and apples. A has a faint reflection on the table. B has a harder horizon line and a cast shadow. Neither adds props or clutter.

A shows a ship deck with a low plank wall beside the barrel, which is simple and muted. B adds a railing with several posts across the back and a stronger cast shadow. Its planks are brighter and more saturated, so the environment is a little busier.
pairs.fix: Use a quieter deck with one large low wall shape. Drop the railing posts and tone the planks down.

pairs.difference: Both put the taxi on a road with a blue sunburst sky and a few lane marks. A has small dashes. B has large white stripes and a grey road. Both are simple, with no extra props.

A is crowded. It has a lantern on a rock, red bedding and a pillow inside the tent, rope-wrapped stakes, yellow flowers, bushes, light rays and detailed trees. It also invents story props the tent would not have. B is just a tent on grass with a few large quiet trees and a soft haze behind it.
pairs.fix: Show only the tent on a grass clearing with a few large, quiet tree shapes behind it. Remove the lantern, rocks, flowers, bedding and rope decoration.

pairs.difference: A is cluttered. It has a veggie crate at the left, a stump with parsley at the right, a ring of rocks, stacked logs, rope knots, flames, grass tufts and a vivid teal forest. The pot also holds many soup ingredients. B is sparse: a pot, a simple log fire, two poles and a muted forest.
pairs.fix: Show only the pot on a simple pole frame over a small fire. Use a plain muted forest and bare dirt. Remove the crate, stump, rock ring, rope wraps and garnish.

pattern: Generated cards add invented story props, such as lanterns, crates, stumps, rocks and bedding, and fill the environment with many small details. Their backgrounds are more saturated and busy. They sometimes add a glow or halo around the hero, where real cards keep the backdrop quiet and the hero central. When both cards are simple, staging gives no signal.
